# Scene Graph Analysis

Generated: 2026-11-27

## Scope and method

Analyzed **3633 scenes** from [assets/data/scenedata.gd](assets/data/scenedata.gd) and 85 event files under [assets/data/events/](assets/data/events/). Enemy victory targets come from [assets/data/enemydata.gd](assets/data/enemydata.gd); quest stages come from `scenedata.quests`; inline text calls are resolved through [localization/en/main.gd](localization/en/main.gd).

- **Followed by A -> B:** an option in any base/variation body has literal `code = B`, or a literal `quest_fight` option resolves through `Enemydata.encounters[args].win_effects` to a `start_event` whose `data` is `B`.
- **Preceded by B -> A:** the reverse of those option edges, plus any recursively nested `add_timed_event.value`, `plan_mansion_event.value`, or `plan_loc_event.event` in B equal to A, plus any `progress_quest` effect in B whose `(value, stage)` is positively checked by A's base or variation `reqs` via `active_quest_stage` or `any_quest_stage`.
- **Strict boundary:** `fight_skirmish`, `winscene`, `scene_code` variation dispatch, `plan_loan_event`, runtime-generated names, mods, gallery copies, and non-scene event registries are not grouping edges because they are outside the supplied iff definitions.
- **Variations:** G1 is assigned when any base/variation body has `scene_type = 'ero_scene'`. G2/G4 evaluate each variation independently as requested; edge extraction still retains every base and variation option/effect.
- **Non-vacuous sets:** G2 requires at least one option and every option must resolve to one or more G1/G2 scenes. G3 requires at least one predecessor and every predecessor must be G1/G3. Builtin, terminal, dynamic, missing, or mixed-target options count as other options for G4.
- **Overlap policy:** groups are computed as sets, then each scene receives one primary group in priority order G1 -> G2 -> G3 -> G4 -> G5. Raw overlaps are reported below.
- **Text-call terminology:** the runtime has no `common_event` directive. Custom calls are `{custom_text_function=...}`; common calls are the shared `{random_chat=...}` and `{random_chat_active|...}` handlers. Text-line `bonus_effects` that dispatch/schedule events are listed separately. Formatting, URLs, colours, checks, and random alternative text are not treated as event calls.

| 1 | Ero scenes | 370 |

Raw G2/G3 overlaps (primary G2): **11**. Raw G3/G4 overlaps (primary G3): **3**.

G2/G3 overlap scenes: `aire_amelia3`, `aire_amelia4`, `aire_amelia5`, `kuro_hideout_sex2`, `kuro_tome_sex2`, `kuro_zeph_tailjob`, `kuro_zeph_tailjob2`, `kuro_zeph_tailjob3`, `zephyra_lilia_4_3`, `zephyra_lilia_5`, `zephyra_lilia_6`.
